title_en: The Stance of Sunni Scholars on the Hadith That God Created Adam in His Image (Part 2)
description_en: The stance of Sunni scholars on the hadith that God created Adam in his image, Part 2. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part two covering Sunni scholarly interpretations of the hadith on creating Adam in the divine image.
